rendering_contract: Candidate wording for S45 deterministic distribution rendering; each queried state has a branch, all probabilities remain visible. No probability threshold or posterior-ranked treatment selection is defined. Urgent banner renders from saved inputs in parallel with review topics. Whether outputs behave as deterministic rules or estimated tables is an open assumption for owner review; this wording assumes neither.
disclosures: Experimental, uncalibrated and unapproved; not a prescription.
An absent case is not_applicable and claims no posterior; it is never a negative finding or a fake negative review posterior.
Unresolved, unknown, not_assessed, missing or conflicting required context pauses; absent is never coerced from not assessed and no missing finding maps to No.

BARS supports measurement; its total alone never establishes diagnosis and no BARS score threshold determines intervention; a global 2 or greater is a review candidate only and pseudoakathisia requires reassessment rather than assumption.
Urgent banner comes from saved structured urgent inputs, not model output, and never shows a fabricated risk percentage.
No dose, route, frequency or active/stopped fields are collected or accepted; prescribing details are background only and not copied as activation metadata.
